# Yelp Advertising 101: How to Find Success with Yelp Ads

Author: [Susie Marino](https://localiq.com/author/susie/)

Last Updated: January 13, 2025|[Local Marketing](https://localiq.com/blog/category/local-marketing/)

[](https://localiq.com/blog/yelp-ads/#top-of-content)

For local businesses, claiming your profile on Yelp for free is a no-brainer. After all, the platform connects neighboring customers with your business when they’re in need of a product or service they can trust. It allows your business to grow its online reputation through customer reviews, plus you get a chance to highlight key business information, photos, and more.

However, did you know there’s a way to make Yelp an even more effective strategy for your business? Yelp advertising is the natural next step for businesses already taking advantage of Yelp organically. Today, we’ll cover everything you need to know about Yelp ads and give you the tools you need to get started—and get results—fast.

### Contents

*   [What is Yelp advertising?](https://localiq.com/blog/yelp-ads/#what-is-yelp-advertising)
*   [How does Yelp advertising work?](https://localiq.com/blog/yelp-ads/#how-do-yelp-ads-work)
*   [Benefits of Yelp advertising](https://localiq.com/blog/yelp-ads/#yelp-benefits)
*   [How much do Yelp ads cost?](https://localiq.com/blog/yelp-ads/#how-much-do-yelp-ads-cost)
*   [How to advertise on Yelp](https://localiq.com/blog/yelp-ads/#how-to-advertise-on-yelp)
*   [Yelp advertising tips](https://localiq.com/blog/yelp-ads/#yelp-ads-tips)
*   [Getting started with Yelp ads](https://localiq.com/blog/yelp-ads/#get-started-with-yelp-ads)

## What is Yelp advertising?

Yelp [advertising](https://localiq.com/blog/types-of-advertising/) is an opportunity for your business to pay for key placements on the Yelp website and app. For example, Yelp ads appear in the “Sponsored Results” sections above and below organic Yelp search results, and they also show on competitor pages.

![yelp ads - yelp ad example](//localiq.com/wp-content/plugins/a3-lazy-load/assets/images/lazy_placeholder.gif)

💡 **Ready to learn more ways your business can dominate the local search market?** Download our free [pocket guide to local SEO](https://localiq.com/resources/local-seo-pocket-guide/?cid=Web_LiQ_InContent_TextLink_SEOPocketGuide_Download&itm_source=localiq&itm_medium=blog&itm_campaign=incontent_links).

## How does Yelp advertising work?

With Yelp advertising, you provide key business information, specify which [PPC (pay per click) keywords](https://localiq.com/blog/keyword-research-for-ppc/) and locations you want to target, and set a [campaign budget](https://localiq.com/blog/marketing-budget/). Then, Yelp decides how to best serve your ad across the platform whenever users within your targeted location search for a business, product, or service that aligns with your chosen keywords.

When a user clicks on a Yelp ad, it prompts them to take an action, like visiting your [Yelp page](https://localiq.com/blog/how-to-claim-a-business-on-yelp/), requesting a quote, or messaging your business—this is how Yelp ads could increase your conversion rates.

Any business can advertise on Yelp, as there is no minimum budget or minimum number of reviews needed to start a campaign. You can even run ads on an unclaimed profile, but claiming your profile on Yelp will unlock more Yelp ads features, like the “Request a Quote” option (more on this later).

![yelp ads - screenshot of first step to claim your business on yelp](//localiq.com/wp-content/plugins/a3-lazy-load/assets/images/lazy_placeholder.gif)

## Is Yelp advertising worth it?

Yelp advertising can be crucial for growing businesses because it [helps your brand stand out](https://localiq.com/blog/how-to-make-your-business-stand-out/) to local potential customers. Consider these Yelp ads benefits and statistics:

*   **Yelp ads can make your business more prominent on smaller screens.** [79%](https://localiq.com/blog/reputation-management/10-online-reputation-stats-will-blow-your-mind-infographic/) of Yelp searches are done on a mobile device. With less screen space for most Yelp searches, paying for priority placements can be crucial.
*   [**Yelp ads can drive reviews**](https://localiq.com/blog/how-to-get-yelp-reviews/)**.** A one-star increase on Yelp can increase a business’s revenue by up to [9%.](https://www.invespcro.com/blog/the-importance-of-online-customer-reviews-infographic/)
*   **Yelp ads can increase sales.** Almost [100%](https://review42.com/resources/online-reviews-statistics/) of Yelp’s visitors have made a purchase from a business listed on the site.
*   **Yelp ads set you apart from industry competition.** With [8 million](https://business.yelp.com/products/yelp-ads/) active claimed businesses on Yelp, your competition is likely also on the platform. Yelp ads can help you get ahead of your competitors on Yelp—they even show on competitor pages.
*   **Yelp ads secure more leads for your business.** Businesses that use Yelp ads get nearly [three times](https://business.yelp.com/products/yelp-ads/) more leads on average.
*   **Yelp ads are cost-effective.** We’ll get more into this in the next section.

You can start and stop your Yelp ads at any time, so trying out Yelp ads is a low-risk, high-reward advertising opportunity you won’t want to miss.

## How Do Yelp Ads Work? Our Complete Guide to Yelp Advertising (2026)

July 28, 2025

![](https://www.icatchgroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/3.png)

Yelp Ads are a pay-per-click (PPC) advertising platform designed to help local businesses appear at the top of search results when users are actively looking for services. Unlike platforms built for discovery or passive browsing, Yelp advertising is focused on capturing users at the moment they are comparing options and preparing to choose a provider. 

When someone searches for a service such as “plumber near me” or “dry cleaning delivery service,” Yelp places relevant businesses in high-visibility positions across search results and competitor listings. This positioning allows businesses to insert themselves directly into the decision-making process, where visibility, reputation, and trust determine who gets the call.

## **How Yelp Advertising Works**

At its core, Yelp Ads operate on a [cost-per-click model](https://www.icatchgroup.com/how-much-do-yelp-ads-cost/), where businesses set a monthly budget and are charged only when users click on their listing. However, what makes Yelp advertising different is not just how it charges, but where those clicks happen in the customer journey.

The Yelp Ads process follows a structured, high-intent path that moves users from search to decision. A business begins by setting a monthly budget, which Yelp uses to distribute visibility across relevant searches and placements. Ads appear in key locations, including:

*   The top of search results
*   Category and service-based listings
*   Competitor business pages

Users encounter these listings while actively searching, which means the traffic generated is already highly qualified. When a listing stands out based on reviews, ratings, and presentation, users click through to learn more. From there, they enter the evaluation phase, where they read reviews, compare providers, and assess credibility.

This stage is what defines Yelp’s advantage. Unlike broader advertising platforms, Yelp captures users when they are no longer researching generally, but narrowing down their final choice. Once confident, users take action by calling, messaging, or booking, and Yelp collects this interaction data to continuously refine campaign performance.

## **What Determines Yelp Ad Cost and Visibility**

Yelp advertising costs are influenced by your monthly budget, but visibility and performance are driven by much more than spend. The platform prioritizes businesses that users are most likely to trust and engage with, which means profile quality directly impacts both cost efficiency and results.

The most important factors that influence visibility and cost include:

*   Review volume, rating, and recency
*   Profile completeness and service descriptions
*   Photo quality and overall presentation
*   User engagement and interaction history

Because Yelp’s system is built around user behavior, stronger profiles tend to receive better placement and more efficient cost per click. This is why businesses often see better results by improving their listing rather than simply increasing their budget.

You can see how this plays out in real campaigns in our [Mighty Dry Yelp case study](https://www.icatchgroup.com/case-studies/mighty-dry/), where a restoration company scaled rapidly by capturing high-intent demand.

## **What Businesses Perform Best on Yelp**

Yelp advertising works best for businesses that rely on trust, local visibility, and quick decision-making. These are typically service-based industries where customers are actively searching for solutions and comparing providers before taking action.

Industries such as plumbing, water damage restoration, legal services, and healthcare consistently perform well because their customers are highly motivated and ready to hire. In contrast, businesses with long sales cycles, niche B2B offerings, or low reliance on reviews tend to see weaker results, since Yelp is not designed for early-stage discovery.

If you’re unsure whether your business is a good fit, [our guide](https://www.icatchgroup.com/is-yelp-advertising-right-for-your-business/) breaks down the industries and conditions where Yelp performs best.

## **Yelp Ads vs Google Ads – Key Differences**

Understanding how Yelp Ads compare to Google Ads is essential for building an effective strategy. While both platforms operate on a pay-per-click model, they serve very different roles within the customer journey.

Google Ads generates significantly higher traffic volume because it captures users across a wide range of search intent, including early research and general information queries. This often leads to more total leads, but also introduces variability in lead quality and lower average conversion rates.

Yelp Ads, on the other hand, generate less traffic overall but focus on users who are already in the decision stage. This results in stronger conversion rates and more consistent lead quality, as users are actively evaluating businesses and preparing to choose a provider.

The key differences can be summarized clearly:

*   Google Ads drives volume and broad demand across all stages of the funnel
*   Yelp Ads captures high-intent users who are closer to making a decision
*   Google produces more total leads, while Yelp produces more qualified leads per click

When used together, these platforms complement each other by covering both demand generation and demand capture.

# Understanding your Yelp Ads Performance

Article also available in:English (United States)

In this article, we’ll take a look at four advertising data points that will help you understand how to evaluate your performance on Yelp and take the right actions to improve the performance of your Yelp Ads program.  

Understanding your click-through-rate: Is your ad driving customers to your Yelp page?

Understanding lead-through-rate: Are you getting new customers?

Understanding your cost-per-lead: What is your cost to acquire a lead on Yelp?

Understanding your return on ad spend: Are you seeing a return on ad spend?
